issues.description: CRIT-001 in the report states Mice production values are consistent, but then identifies a documentation clarity issue. This is correctly categorized as a documentation issue, not a critical issue - the values themselves are consistent.
issues.suggestion: Consider relabeling CRIT-001 as a documentation issue or downgrading to Major, since the actual numeric values are confirmed consistent.

issues.description: CRIT-002 correctly identifies hit chance formula discrepancies. Verified: combat-mechanics.md uses 70% base, combat-algorithm.md uses 50% base, and AGENTS.md uses a simplified version. The report's resolution is sound.
issues.suggestion: No change needed - issue is correctly identified and resolution is appropriate.

issues.description: MAJ-005 correctly identifies base growth rate conflict: population-growth.md uses 0.10 (10%), while race-stats-complete.md lists BASE_GROWTH_RATE as 0.02. This is a legitimate inconsistency that needs resolution.
issues.suggestion: Verified as accurate finding. The 10% rate in population-growth.md appears more consistent with MOO1-style gameplay.

issues.description: The report references slider-mathematics.md which doesn't exist (noted in DOC-001), but factory-formulas.md also references it. This cross-reference validation is correct.
issues.suggestion: Verified as accurate - the missing file reference is correctly identified.

issues.description: MIN-001 variable naming inconsistencies are correctly identified across documents (e.g., Hit_Chance vs hit_chance vs Accuracy). The recommendation to standardize on snake_case is reasonable.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding this to AGENTS.md as a mandatory coding convention.

summary: The consistency report is comprehensive, well-organized, and accurately identifies real inconsistencies across the specification documents. Key findings verified: (1) Hit chance formula discrepancy between combat-mechanics.md (70% base) and combat-algorithm.md (50% base) is real and significant; (2) Base growth rate conflict (0.10 vs 0.02) is correctly identified; (3) Engine cost/space values differ between ship-costs.md and components-complete.md; (4) Racial bonus documentation for Ferrets, Budgies, and Hamsters needs clarification regarding attack vs damage vs defense mechanics. The report provides clear canonical source recommendations and a verification checklist for future updates. The severity classifications are appropriate, the resolutions are actionable, and the document structure makes it easy to track fixes. Minor suggestion: some 'Critical' issues are more documentation clarity than actual formula conflicts.
